title: Codex Ultimus: The Unbroken Fold
statement: The last letter is never merely words; it is an architecture of departure, folded until its margins fracture into tesserae. I laid down an 8x8 matrix of archival vellum and iron-gall glyphs, sealed at its core with carmine wax that has begun to shatter under time's pressure. What remains is a scaffold of unfinished syntax waiting for another hand to write into the vacant tiles.
process: Constructed an epistolary grid of repeating glyph cells and vellum fragments using modular defs, scored by crease vectors and an off-axis wax medallion. I introduced progressive erosion from the top-left archive toward the vacant, bleached quadrants of the lower right.
